positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Simulations · C++ · Computer Vision · Robotics · Python (Programming Language)

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Student Design Team President
positions.description:
Managed a team of 70+ engineering students to develop a fully autonomous boat

Competed in the Robonation Roboboat competition, winning 1st place in the static judging portion

Led the LIDAR group on the software team, developing an object detection and tracking system

positions.title: ADAS Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked with a team of engineers to design a Level 2+ Autonomous Highway Driving system

Developed a fully automated pipeline to evaluate key performance indicators of the system

Collaborated with a team of interns and engineers to design a novel method of representing the static environment around the vehicle on a low memory embedded system

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Redesigned a self-driving car system written in C++ and Rust to allow testing at 10 times faster than real time

Created a behavior graphing tool using Python and used this tool to resolve inconsistent decision making in an autonomous vehicle

Designed a React dashboard for searching and accessing thousands of hours of vehicle data logs

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Developed a React Native application to allow student organizations to rapidly exchange all of their social media accounts and contact information. Competed in multiple startup pitch competitions and ran beta tests with 300+ member organizations. Successfully submitted the app "Pakochi" to both the App Store and Google Play Store. Concluded in December of 2017 when the Co-founders decided to seek other professional opportunities.
